name: targetprocess-mcp
description: MCP server connecting Claude to Targetprocess REST API

tp_token.title: Targetprocess API Token
tp_token.description: Settings -> Authentication and Security -> New Access Token

tp_base_url.title: Targetprocess Base URL
tp_base_url.description: Your Targetprocess API endpoint, e.g. https://yourcompany.tpondemand.com/api/v1

tp_owner_id.title: Targetprocess Owner ID
tp_owner_id.description: Your Targetprocess user ID (find via the get_logged_in_user tool)

tp_project_id.title: Targetprocess Project ID
tp_project_id.description: Default project ID (find via the get_projects tool)

tp_team_id.title: Targetprocess Team ID
tp_team_id.description: Default team ID (find via the get_teams tool)
